name: emulator-tests
description: Tests for firestore.rules and the Cloud Functions, run against the Firebase emulators.

scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
scripts.test:rules: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-rules "node emulator-tests/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:functions: npm run build --prefix ../functions && cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions --project demo-functions "node --test emulator-tests/functions.test.mjs"
